Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Eric Bledsoe?

Eric Bledsoe is 36 years old.

Where was Eric Bledsoe born?

Eric Bledsoe was born in Birmingham, Alabama.

When was Eric Bledsoe born?

Eric Bledsoe was born on December 9, 1989.

How tall is Eric Bledsoe?

Eric Bledsoe is 6-1 (185 cm) tall.

How much did Eric Bledsoe weigh when playing?

Eric Bledsoe weighed 214 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Eric Bledsoe in the Hall of Fame?

Eric Bledsoe is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Eric Bledsoe drafted?

Eric Bledsoe was drafted by Oklahoma City Thunder, 1st round (18th pick, 18th overall), 2010 NBA Draft.

What position did Eric Bledsoe play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

When did Eric Bledsoe retire?

Eric Bledsoe last played in 2022.

What is Eric Bledsoe's net worth?

Eric Bledsoe made at least $130,701,423 playing professional basketball.

How much did Eric Bledsoe make?

Eric Bledsoe made $18,125,000 in 2022.

What did Eric Bledsoe average?

Eric Bledsoe averaged 13.7 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 4.7 assists per game.

How many rings does Eric Bledsoe have?

Eric Bledsoe won 0 championships.

What is Eric Bledsoe's Instagram account?

Eric Bledsoe is on Instagram at thebledshow.

What schools did Eric Bledsoe attend?

Eric Bledsoe attended A.H. Parker in Birmingham, Alabama and Kentucky.

What are Eric Bledsoe's nicknames?

Mini-Lebron is a nickname for Eric Bledsoe.
